venues_block_already_started: This event already has a checklist from that building.
venues_block_venue_required: Choose which building this checklist is for.
checklist_panelIntro: What has to happen before the doors open, and afterwards. The building wrote it; you work through it.
checklist_none: No checklist has been started for this event.
checklist_noTemplates: There is no checklist to start — ask the building, or pick a venue first.
checklist_snapshotNote: Your copy is a snapshot: a later edit by the building is offered to you, never applied behind your back.
checklist_newItems: This building has changed this checklist since you started.
checklist_publishBlocked: This event has a room, so it cannot be published until every required item is at least under way.
checklist_allSettled: Everything required is under way or done.
checklist_noDue: No date — this event has no time set yet.
checklist_signoffNeeded: The building signs this one off
checklist_naReasonPlaceholder: There is no catering at this event
checklist_evidenceFileNotYet: Attaching a file here is not built yet — leave a note or a link instead.
checklist_error: That did not work. Try again.
checklist_block_na_not_allowed: The building does not allow this item to be waved away.
checklist_block_na_reason_required: Say why this does not apply.
checklist_block_needs_venue_signoff: Only the building can mark this one done. You can say it is under way.
checklist_block_no_signoff_needed: This item does not need the building’s signature.
checklist_block_not_allowed: You are not allowed to change this item.
checklist_block_checklist_pending: A required checklist item has not been started, so this event cannot be published yet.
